scope: Isolated local production Docker images with disposable PostgreSQL18; no hosted or existing local app/database changes and no model requests.

fixture.method: Fetch actual SSR before navigation; advance only browser Date by one minute or one UTC day; replay unchanged SSR; test first donation click and unchanged server snapshot through range changes; require no browser page errors.

old.failure: Rendered snapshot used independently advanced browser clock rather than server snapshot.

fixed.dockerBuild: passed once using existing cache; no root .next build
checks: Minute boundary and UTC-day boundary both retain the original server snapshot.
Initial donation opens, accepts typed amount, and closes; chart range control remains usable.
No page errors in either fixed clock-boundary test.
All three delayed acknowledgement and stale donation response regressions pass.

limitations: The original fixture clock update inside a blocked navigation route deadlocked before hydration; that setup failure was excluded and corrected before the reported comparison.
Initial donation click succeeded in the controlled old-image runs; these results prove hydration mismatch and snapshot drift, not deterministic reproduction of a lost click.
Raw traces remain temporary because they contain disposable session identifiers; only sanitized hydration error summaries are retained.
cleanup: Disposable old/fixed app containers, PostgreSQL18 container and its anonymous volume, and test Docker network removed after verification; original cached images retained.
